[[File:Jacen_light.jpg|thumb|right|[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] achieves a state of oneness during his final duel with [[Onimi]].]]
'''Oneness''' was the state of union with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. In some circumstances, individuals managed to become akin to a living manifestation of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] or on rare occasions, even the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], although they were prone to severe temptations to the dark side.<ref name="TUF" /><ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref> They essentially became nothing more than an extension&mdash;a tool&mdash;of the Force, and were at a perfectly calm state.<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was able to naturally achieve oneness with the Force more than once.<ref name="TUF" /><ref name="Vortex" /> [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] was also able to achieve this state two times, however she only did this with the help of the [[Bota/Legends|bota]] with which she injected herself.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

Some of the Force-sensitives who achieved this included:
*[[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] became one with the dark side per the teachings given him by [[Freedon Nadd]].<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
*[[Darth Malgus]]: Prior to his [[Duel in Adraas's manse|duel]] with [[Adraas]], Malgus recalled the memory of killing [[Eleena Daru]], his lover, who he considered to be his only weakness. This helped him achieve a state where he felt he was one with the Force.<ref name="Deceived" />
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]: He was able to achieve Oneness for the first time during the [[Battle of Praesitlyn]], using both the light and dark sides of the Force to decimate [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces.<ref name="Jedi Trial">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref> While channelling the power of the planet [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]], he was able to become one with the Force again, temporarily becoming powerful enough to subdue the [[Son/Legends|Son]] and [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]].<ref name="Overlords">{{TCW|Overlords}}</ref>
*[[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]: After she had injected herself with [[Bota/Legends|bota]], she experienced a state of Oneness with the Force that she described as being in all [[Time/Legends|times]], all places, and all things. She was recorded as doing this on two separate occasions, and both times entered this state as a result.<ref name="MedStar II" />
*[[Jax Pavan]]: After escaping a confrontation with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], he momentarily experienced the same state of being that Barriss Offee had. In the absence of any conscious effort to bring it about, he concluded that it was the will of the Force that had made it possible, reassuring him that he was doing the right thing.<ref name="Coruscant Nights III">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
*[[Galen Marek]]: On the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1]], as he held back the Emperor's lightning to allow his friends to escape, Marek gave himself completely to the light side, for a single moment accessing enormous power. His body collapsed under his newfound blazing internal power and the Sith lightning he held back, then in a final moment as he perished he [[Pyrokinesis|evoked a firestorm]], his flames burning [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to ashes, though only staggering Palpatine and Vader.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>
*[[Anakin Solo]]: On the [[Mission to Myrkr|Myrkr mission]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] he entered into a state of Oneness, regaining all of his prowess for combat, and spontaneously striking his opponents with [[Electric Judgment|lightning]]. However, Solo was already dying, and while he restored his fighting skills briefly, his body died even faster as it was consumed by the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]].<ref name="Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>
*[[Ganner Rhysode]]: While in captivity on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], his acceptance of his desire to be a hero allowed him to enter a state of Oneness, where he managed to single-handedly [[Battle of the World-Well|hold off and kill many of the]] several thousand Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]], embracing his role as a slaughterer, before finally collapsing the roof of the [[Senate Hall]] to wipe out the rest of the Yuuzhan Vong forces and their battle creatures just before he was slain.<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]: On the way to confront [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane|Shimrra]] he slew countless Yuuzhan Vong as well as many [[Slayers]] in a state that was described by his nephew [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] as a maelstrom of luminous Force energy that poured from a calm center. It was a maelstrom in which Skywalker did not appear to be present either physically or as an individual personality, having completely surrendered himself to the will of the Force. Skywalker considered entering this state to have great risks of drawing him to the Dark Side, however.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> Later, an exhausted Skywalker briefly became one with the Force to gain enough power to kill one of Abeloth's bodies, though some of his cells were destroyed by the power unleashed in this state. After the battle, Luke was able to heal however.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>  Later, after passing through the [[Unidentified monolith]], he became one with the Force again, making a shroud of [[Color/Legends|golden]] [[Electric Judgment|Force lightning]] around himself and killing his foes with the power of [[golden flash]].<ref name="Crucible" />
*[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]: In the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|final battle]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Solo achieved a total oneness with the Force, becoming a being of glowing light and using this power to defeat [[Onimi]], the true mastermind behind the war. While in this state, Jacen felt as if he had broken past the concepts of light and dark and understood the true nature of the Force. When he returned to his normal form, Solo perceived it not possible for him to ever achieve oneness again.<ref name="TUF" />
*[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]: When fighting Darth Caedus, Jaina briefly entered a state of Oneness for part of their duel, replenishing her [[Personal Force reservoir|power]] and health for a few moments. Then the moment of unity with Ashla was gone and she was left to fight on her own power.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>
*[[Ben Skywalker]]: During [[Duel at the Font of Power|the duel]] between Skywalker and [[Vestara Khai]] against [[Abeloth]] at the [[Font of Power]], Skywalker opened himself completely to the Force in order to fight Abeloth and protect Khai. He felt himself become one with the Force, but even in this state he was only able to slightly harm the dark side entity, despite hitting Abeloth with a Force blast that would have been able to knock an entire [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] out of orbit.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
*[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] became one with the dark side using her anger and later the light side of the Force after entering the [[Unidentified monolith]]. While in this state she created a shell of golden [[Electric Judgment|Force lightning]] around herself and also used the power of [[golden flash]] to [[Fire/Legends|burn]] her foes to nothingness.<ref name="Crucible" />
